title: 20 Minute Violent Prayer AGAINST CLOSED DOORS AND REJECTIONS
text: Beloved in Christ, hear me very carefully tonight. The Lord has sent me as a voice of prophecy to somebody under the sound of my voice. This year will not end with your documents trapped in delay. Heaven has sent me to announce to you that by the authority of the word of God, every door that has been shut before you shall be opened. Every system that has rejected you must bow to the authority of Jesus Christ. your visa, your permit, your approval, your settlement, your contract by fire, it must be released in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Revelation 3:7 to8, "These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutth, and shutth, and no man openeth. I know thy works. Behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it. That is your testimony. If God says the door is open, no government can shut it. If God says the door is open, no system can resist it. If God says the door is open, no policy can turn it back. I decree and declare right now, let every closed consulate door open. Let every immigration file that has gathered dust under satanic embgo be remembered for favor. Let every satanic handwriting speaking rejection against your destiny be blotted out by the blood of Jesus by fire. Your visa must be approved. There are people here who have been mocked because of endless delays. Psalm 126:12:22 says, "When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream." Then was our mouth filled with laughter and our tongue with singing. Then said they among the hidden, "The Lord has done great things for them." The Lord is about to do something in your life that will look like a dream. That denial letter will be overturned. That rejection email will be replaced with an approval. That delay that has lasted months and years will collapse in one night. Lift your voice in warfare prayer. I prophesy over your documents. They will not be misplaced. They will not be rejected. They will not be delayed. I decree supernatural remembrance. Angels of favor are carrying your file to the top of the pile. Whoever must be moved, removed, or replaced for your breakthrough to manifest, let heaven arrange it now in the name of Jesus. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand. When heaven opens, men cannot close it. Tonight I decree over your destiny, let the heavens open for you. Let your visa be approved. Let your travel be successful. Let your settlement be established. Lift up this dangerous decree. By the blood of Jesus, every embargo on my mobility breaks. By the fire of God, I silence demonic voices speaking against me in consulates, in offices, in decision rooms. By divine authority, I command my docu command my documents to receive approval. By the word of God, I walk through my open door. Thus saith the spirit of God. Someone under the sound of my voice, you have been denied more than three times and now fear has settled in your heart. Tonight the siege of rejection is broken. Another person, your own family member placed an evil embargo on you declaring that you will not travel. Tonight by the fire of God that covenant is broken. Whoever said you will not cross borders, I stand as a prophet and decree you shall cross by fire. Now engage in militant warfare. Every course of rejection break now. Every ancestral altar speaking no be silenced by the blood. Every witchcraft spell tying my destiny down scatter in the name of Jesus. I decree arrows of rejection fired against my visa return to sender. Beloved, the Bible says in Psalm 24 7-9, lift I decree and declare prophetically before the end of this year, your testimony will be loud. Men will see it and glorify God. Kings will favor you. Authorities will bow to the name of Jesus upon your life. No devil, no policy, no altar can resist your approval. By the blood of Jesus, your visa is released. Your door is open. Your destiny is established. Amen and amen. Lift up your voices in thanksgiving to the one who holds times and seasons in his hands. The word of God says in Psalm 75:6-7, "For exaltation comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south, but God is the judge. He puts down one and exalts another." When it comes to the lifting of men, it is not merely about systems. It is not merely about governments. It is not merely about embassies or officials. It is the God of heaven that opens doors. Today's prophetic focus is this. Angels of favor, locate my visa application now. No more delay. Instant visa approval prayer for international open doors. There are many under the sound of my voice who are weary of denials, who are tired of delays, who have cried and asked, "Lord, when will my breakthrough come?" And the spirit of God says, "Today is the day of remembrance, for Isaiah 60:11 declares, "Therefore, your gates shall be opened continually. They shall not be shut day or night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the Gentiles, and their kings in procession. Every gate that has been shut against you will be opened continually." Beloved, you must understand that favor is a spirit. Exodus 3:21 says, "And I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it shall be when you go that you shall not go emptyhanded." Visa approval is not just about paperwork, it is about favor. Contracts are not just about signatures, they are about favor. international doors. And now I decree, angels of favor, locate their applications. Now Hebrews 1:14 says, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation?" Ministering spirits, go forth. Enter consulates, enter embassies, enter offices, stand beside the files, stand beside the documents. Whisper favor into the ears of decision makers. Every spirit of delay, break. Every embargo on international doors, break. Every voice of rejection, be silenced. That negative handwriting is nailed to the cross. I decree by prophecy doors of nations open for you. Double doors are opening for you. The gates of nations will not be shut against you. I decree super. I prophesy speed. Angels of favor, locate my visa now. Angels of favor, speak for me now. Angels of favor, go ahead of me now. [Music] I speak to you by the spirit. Your season of rejection is over. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Walk into embassies with boldness. Walk into consulates with confidence. Raise this dangerous cry. Every power saying over my dead body will you travel. Let the fire of God answer them. Every evil priest sitting on my file, let thunder strike them down. Every embgo of witchcraft on my name break by fire. The Lord is showing me people whose visas were denied because of forged accusations, false allegations, manipulated documents, demonic lies. Hear me. Psalm 35:1 says, "Plead my cause, oh Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them that fight against me." Tonight, God himself is pleading your case. Every false witness collapses. Every lie against you is silenced. Every manipulated evidence is erased by the fire of God. Thus sayeth the Lord, someone listening right now, tomorrow you will hear good news, a call, an email, an unexpected reversal. Heaven has moved. Receive it in the name of Jesus. Pray with holy violence. I command every satanic arrow fired at my documents backfire. Every satanic delay scatter by fire. Every closed door opened by force, angels of favor go to work on my behalf. Hear me. Favor is not natural. It is spiritual. Psalm 102:13 declares, "Thou shalt arise and have mercy upon Zion, for the time to favor her. Yay, the set time is come. I prophesy over you. Your set time has come. No witchcraft can delay it. No divine I see chains breaking right now. I see gates opening. I see angels moving into offices placing your file on the desk of decision makers. I see verdicts of no being changed to yes. I see those who mocked you being silenced. I see you celebrating your approval. Father, we give you praise. Thank you because no power can resist you. Thank you because no devil can overturn what you have decreed. Thank you because tonight doors are open, approvals are released, testimonies are birthed. Blessed be your name forever. I decree and declare prophetically by this time next week, someone here will be holding their approval letter. Another will be on their way to the airport. Another will call their family to testify. This is the doing of the Lord and it shall be marvelous in our eyes. Amen and amen. The presence of God is strong and the heavens are open. The spirit of God is still moving. Angels are still on assignment and the word of God is still speaking. The decree this morning remains unshakable. Angels of favor, locate my visa application now. No more delay. Hear me by the spirit of God, your set time has come. The time to favor you in that consulate. The time to favor you in that embassy. The time to favor you before officials. The time to favor you before decision makers. It has come. No more postponement. No more denial. No more delay. Lift your hands and declare with faith. Father, I receive my set time. Father, I receive my day of favor. Father, I receive instant approval. I decree and declare over you this morning, angels of favor are walking into those offices. Ministering spirits are aligning decisions in your favor. The Lord is rewriting protocol. Every power of delay, break. Every chain of denial, break. Every voice of resistance be silenced. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. Every tongue of judgment that has spoken denied over you, I condemn it now in the name of Jesus. I prophesy international open doors." Say, in the name of Jesus, I step into international favor. I step into supernatural approval. I step into my open door. I decrease supernatural speed. As you pray, systems are being aligned. As you pray, doors are opening. I decree that your season of shame is over.
